projects.title: Student Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES)
projects.description: Six-month industrial attachment with the Department of Computer Engineering, Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. Work covered practical computer networking tasks such as LAN configuration and topology testing, routine hardware diagnostics and system assembly, and general IT support duties within a university engineering environment.

projects.title: Diploma in Computer System Engineering
projects.description: Capstone coursework for the Diploma in Computer System Engineering, focused on foundational computer hardware assembly, system diagnostics and troubleshooting, and an introduction to networking principles that now underpin the writer's degree studies.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website (This Site)
projects.description: A dependency-free, multi-page personal portfolio built with semantic XHTML/HTML5 and pure CSS (Grid and Flexbox), using JSON for structured content and JSON-LD for search-engine metadata, with no JavaScript or CMS platform involved.

projects.title: Maigoro Enterprises
projects.description: Founded and operated a clothing line and custom fashion design accessories brand, covering brand identity, apparel sourcing, client relations and digital outreach alongside full-time engineering studies.
